name: NJM2082 / NJM2082DD (New JRC / Nisshinbo JFET-input dual, improved NJM082)
tagline: New JRC's faster (20 V/us) improved NJM082 JFET dual; Japanese DIY listeners rate it a fuller, more composed swap for the TL072/NJM072.
technology: Dual J-FET-input op-amp. The datasheet calls it an improved version of the NJM082 (TL082-class), with low input offset and bias current, 10^12 ohm input resistance, 20 V/us slew and a +/-4 V to +/-18 V supply range. Intended uses: fast integrators, DACs, sample-and-hold and audio. NJM2082DD is sold by Japanese retailers as a noise-screened DIP grade.

part_numbers.notes: Base part. English datasheet NJM2082_E, Ver.2003-03-17. The current lifecycle status at Nisshinbo was not confirmed.
DIP8 (0.300 in). Also appears in listings as 'NJM#2082D'; the meaning of the '#' marking was not confirmed.
Noise-screened ('ノイズ選定品') DIP grade, sold by Kyohritsu/eleshop. It is not listed in the 2003 datasheet mirrors seen, and the vendor has not confirmed its screening criteria.
SSOP8 variant, seen only as a datasheet-mirror listing (datasheetq).

lineage.notes: Positioned as an improved NJM082, NJR's second source of the TL082 type.
Formed when NJR merged with Ricoh Electronic Devices. Distributors now list NJM2082D and NJM2082M under Nisshinbo Micro Devices.

reputation.summary: The praise comes from a small number of Japanese hobbyist sources, which this pass did not re-check. The C-Area wiki (higemouse) found the NJM2082D heavier and more composed than the TL072CP, with better low- and high-frequency extension. A zigsow review ('072改', 'improved 072') describes the NJM2082DD as slightly warm like the NJM072 but more neutral, and suited to classical and clean-tone music. The dad8893 blog includes it in a JFET op-amp listening comparison (TL072 / NJM072 / NJM2082 / OPA2134 / MUSES8920).
sonic_descriptors: heavier and more composed than TL072CP (C-Area wiki)
extended lows and highs versus TL072CP (C-Area wiki)
slightly warm like NJM072 but more neutral (zigsow review, DD grade)
typical_uses: op-amp rolling in DIY headphone amps and preamps, as a replacement in TL072/NJM072 sockets
caveats: The impressions are subjective, come from a few Japanese sources, and were not re-verified in this pass.
The DD grade's 'noise-screened' status comes from a retailer and has no vendor specification behind it.
A JFET-input dual has higher voltage noise than bipolar audio duals such as the NJM4580 or NE5532.

revision_history.changes: This is the only revision found in the mirrors. NJR does not publish change logs, and no later Nisshinbo revision was found.

counterfeit_notes: This sweep found no NJM2082-specific counterfeit or remarking reports. The usual caution applies to marketplace-sourced 'DD' parts: the noise screening is a sales grade, and nothing on the package shows it beyond the suffix marking.
open_questions: Has Nisshinbo published a datasheet revision after Ver.2003-03-17? The current version stamp is unknown.
Is the NJM2082 active, NRND or discontinued at Nisshinbo? DigiKey lists NJM2082D and NJM2082M, but their status was not seen.
The vendor has not documented NJM2082DD's screening criteria (noise-selected per the Kyohritsu listing).
Confirm the GBW (5 MHz?) and input noise (13 nV/rtHz?) against the datasheet table.
Does an NJM2082L (SIP8) exist? Only an alldatasheet search page was seen.
What does the '#' mean in 'NJM#2082D' listings: lead-free, or a fab/assembly change?
Were there any post-2022 PCNs (die or fab transfer after the NJR-Ricoh merger)? None found.
The legacy NJR and Nisshinbo PDF URLs in archive_seed_urls are guesses from the naming pattern, not confirmed.

claims_confirmed: The Mouser-hosted NJM2082 datasheet is titled 'DUAL J-FET INPUT OPERATIONAL AMPLIFIER' and stamped Ver.2003-03-17 (https://www.mouser.com/datasheet/2/294/njr_njm2082_e-547184.pdf).
A second Mouser path, NJM2082_E-218423.pdf, carries the same Ver.2003-03-17 (https://www.mouser.com/ds/2/294/NJM2082_E-218423.pdf).
The NJM2082 is described as an improved version of the NJM082, suited for fast integrators, DACs, sample-and-hold and audio (https://www.mouser.com/ds/2/294/NJM2082_E-218423.pdf).
Operating voltage is +/-4 V to +/-18 V, input resistance 10^12 ohm typ, slew rate 20 V/us typ (https://www.mouser.com/datasheet/2/294/njr_njm2082_e-547184.pdf).

DigiKey lists NJM2082M (8-DMP) and NJM2082D under Nisshinbo Micro Devices (https://www.digikey.com/en/products/detail/nisshinbo-micro-devices-inc/NJM2082M/805549, https://www.digikey.com/en/products/detail/njr-corporation-njrc/NJM2082D/673709).
The alldatasheet copy is 5 pages, 226 KB (https://www.alldatasheet.com/datasheet-pdf/pdf/7246/NJRC/NJM2082.html).
A web-search summary gave GBW 5 MHz and noise 13 nV/rtHz. Kept as unconfirmed because they were not read off the datasheet (https://www.mouser.com/datasheet/2/294/njr_njm2082_e-547184.pdf).
